name: Equinix AC1 Accra (MDXi Appolonia)
notes: Plot No 1, Benin Boulevard, Appolonia Industrial Park, Appolonia City (Greater Accra). Equinix official page lists AC1 just outside Accra (~524 sq m / 5,640 sq ft colo space); MDXi Appolonia received Uptime Tier III Constructed Facility (TCCF) certification. Alias: MainOne MDXi Appolonia - do not double count.

name: Onix Accra #1 (Onix Data Centres Ghana)
developer: Onix Data Centres (Ngoya Etix DC (Ghana) Ltd; AIIM majority stake)
notes: Tier IV carrier-neutral colocation at Amrahia (Katamanso Rd), Uptime Tier 4 certified Oct 2021; inaugurated 2022 (DCD reported 12 MW at opening; Ghanaian press/trendsnafrica cite 20 MW design). AIIM case study: 170 racks expandable to 680, partial solar. Alias: Ngoya Etix DC / Etix Accra #1 / Onix Accra 1.

name: PAIX Accra (ACC-1 / RackAfrica)
notes: 42 Ring Road Central, Accra. PAIX official release (21 May 2024) confirms expansion to 1.2 MW IT capacity; facility is Ghana connectivity hub with direct ACE submarine cable access. Alias: RackAfrica (founded 2011, acquired by PAIX 2018).

name: Africa Data Centres Accra (Ghana Trade Fair site, La)
developer: Africa Data Centres (Cassava Technologies), partnered with Onix Data Centres
notes: CBD/La site in Ghana Trade Fair Redevelopment Project; initial 10 MW expandable to 30 MW (announced capacity, A-/B); 2024 Onix partnership (DCD); construction ongoing per 2024 DCD/trendsnafrica coverage; no commissioning source found - NOT operational. 30 MW is announced, not operating.

name: Digital Realty Accra ACR2
notes: Digital Realty's first Ghana facility, launched 2025 in downtown Accra (Bank Street / Prof. Atta Mills High Street); ~1,100 sq m colocation space; LINX Accra peering access point; PeeringDB fac 14469. Capacity MW not disclosed.

name: Agility Logistics Parks Tema Data Centre Campus
notes: Tema Free Trade Zone campus (Greater Accra/Tema). ALP official page lists it among first master-planned data centre campuses; 30 MW committed IT capacity with scale to 150 MW (Fortren & Company report via Nairametrics 2026-07-27); in development - no commissioning source found.

name: Primary Ghana National Data Center Accra (NITA)
notes: Government e-gov data centre in Accra; Uptime Institute award record plus NITA data-centre project page; earlier DCD/NCA coverage describes Tier-3 National Data Centre with ~600 racks. Government/non-commercial facility.

name: NetActuate Accra Data Center (ACC)
notes: US edge/network provider launched Accra data center location Apr 2023; operator states facility houses five submarine cable connections, major carriers/ISPs and direct GIX connectivity; PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, ISO 22301 compliant; capacity not disclosed. May include edge deployment inside partner facility - treat capacity claims cautiously.

name: Ghana Immigration Service Kintampo IT Data Centre
developer: Ghana Immigration Service / Kintampo Municipal Assembly
notes: Government IT data centre at Bono East Regional Command, Kintampo (2022); non-commercial agency server/IT room; no capacity data. Round-one verified lead re-checked against methodology (government rooms qualify as non-commercial records).

name: Ghana E-Gov Cloud Data Center Kumasi (NITA)
notes: Uptime Institute award record for NITA's Kumasi (Ashanti) government cloud data centre; government/non-commercial; commercial colocation in Ashanti unconfirmed. Ashanti is not blank per methodology.

name: Bank of Ghana Kumasi Data Centre & Disaster Recovery Site (Ahinsan)
notes: Central bank DR/data centre at Ahinsan, Kumasi (launched 2018); three-storey building, ~2,890 sq m; enterprise/government facility, not retail colocation.

name: Ghana Link Kumasi Tier IV Data Centre (ICUMS)
notes: New Kumasi Tier IV data centre hosting the Integrated Customs Management System (ICUMS); ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification announced 24 Feb 2026 (Citi Newsroom/BFT); enterprise/government facility.

name: Sekondi-Takoradi Metropolitan Assembly Data Centre (OGP commitment)
notes: OGP commitment GHST0005 includes milestone to develop a data centre and dashboard for Sekondi-Takoradi; official commitment only - no capacity, site or completion confirmation found; treated as planned. No commercial colocation confirmed in Western region.
